index_text.ja: Denoise — total variation denoise ROF TV denoising 全変動ノイズ除去(TV denoising、Chambolle 法)。エッジを保ったまま平坦部のノイズを滑らかにする —— メディアン/ガウスぼかしと違い、輪郭のシャープさを崩しにくいのが特徴。
index_text.en: Denoise — total variation denoise ROF TV denoising Total variation denoising (TV denoising, Chambolle's method). Smooths noise in flat regions while preserving edges - unlike median/Gaussian blur, it is characterized by not easily degrading the sharpness of contours.
index_text.zh: Denoise — total variation denoise ROF TV denoising 全变分去噪（TV denoising，Chambolle 方法）。在保留边缘的同时平滑平坦区域的噪声——与中值/高斯模糊不同，其特点是不易破坏轮廓的锐利度。
index_text.tw: Denoise — total variation denoise ROF TV denoising 全變分去噪（TV denoising，Chambolle 方法）。在保留邊緣的同時平滑平坦區域的雜訊——與中值/高斯模糊不同，其特點是不易破壞輪廓的銳利度。
index_text.ko: Denoise — total variation denoise ROF TV denoising 전변동 노이즈 제거(TV denoising, Chambolle 기법). 에지를 보존하면서 평탄한 영역의 노이즈를 매끄럽게 한다 —— 미디언/가우시안 블러와 달리 윤곽의 선명함을 잘 무너뜨리지 않는 것이 특징이다.
index_text.de: Denoise — total variation denoise ROF TV denoising Total-Variation-Rauschunterdrückung (TV denoising, Chambolle-Verfahren). Glättet das Rauschen in flachen Bereichen bei gleichzeitiger Erhaltung der Kanten - im Unterschied zu Median-/Gauß-Weichzeichnung zeichnet es sich dadurch aus, dass die Schärfe der Konturen nur schwer beeinträchtigt wird.
index_text.hi: Denoise — total variation denoise ROF TV denoising Total variation denoising (TV denoising, Chambolle विधि)। Edges को बचाते हुए समतल हिस्सों का noise smooth करता है —— median/Gaussian blur के विपरीत, इसकी खासियत है कि contour की sharpness आसानी से नहीं बिगड़ती।

recipes.name: Edge — Sobel + Otsu
recipes.when: gradient magnitude thresholded to a binary edge map

index_text.ja: Edge — Sobel + Otsu edge gradient magnitude thresholded to a binary edge map 等方ガウシアン平滑化。HALCON の ``gauss_filter``（Smooth using discrete Gauss functions.）に相当。 Sobel 勾配の振幅(``hypot(sobel_x, sobel_y)`` を正規化)。縦横それぞれの 1 次微分カーネルから勾配ベクトルの大きさを求める最も基本的なエッジ検出。 HALCON の ``sobel_amp``（Detect edges (amplitude) using the Sobel operator.）に相当。 大津の判別分析法（Otsu's method）による自動しきい値処理。HALCON の ``binary_threshold``（Segment an image using binary thresholding.）に相当。
index_text.en: Edge — Sobel + Otsu edge gradient magnitude thresholded to a binary edge map Isotropic Gaussian smoothing. Equivalent to HALCON's ``gauss_filter`` (Smooth using discrete Gauss functions.). The magnitude of the Sobel gradient (normalized ``hypot(sobel_x, sobel_y)``). The most basic edge detection method, computing the magnitude of the gradient vector from the vertical and horizontal first-derivative kernels. Equivalent to HALCON's ``sobel_amp`` (Detect edges (amplitude) using the Sobel operator.). Automatic thresholding using Otsu's method. Equivalent to HALCON's ``binary_threshold`` (Segment an image using binary thresholding.).

Sobel 그래디언트의 진폭(``hypot(sobel_x, sobel_y)``를 정규화). 세로·가로 각각의 1차 미분 커널로부터 그래디언트 벡터의 크기를 구하는 가장 기본적인 에지 검출. index_text.hi: Edge — Sobel + Otsu edge gradient magnitude thresholded to a binary edge map Isotropic Gaussian smoothing। HALCON के ``gauss_filter`` (Smooth using discrete Gauss functions.) के समकक्ष है। Sobel gradient का amplitude (``hypot(sobel_x, sobel_y)`` को normalise किया गया)। खड़ी और आड़ी दिशा के क्रम 1 वाले derivative kernels से gradient vector का magnitude निकालने वाला सबसे बुनियादी edge detection। HALCON के ``sobel_amp`` (Detect edges (amplitude) using the Sobel operator.) के समकक्ष है। Otsu की discriminant analysis method (Otsu's method) से automatic thresholding। HALCON के ``binary_threshold`` (Segment an image using binary thresholding.) के समकक्ष है।

index_text.ja: Segment — blob / coin segment smooth, threshold, fill holes, drop specks 等方ガウシアン平滑化。HALCON の ``gauss_filter``（Smooth using discrete Gauss functions.）に相当。 大津の判別分析法（Otsu's method）による自動しきい値処理。HALCON の ``binary_threshold``（Segment an image using binary thresholding.）に相当。 領域内部の穴(背景に完全に囲まれた領域)を埋める (``ndimage.binary_fill_holes``)。外周とつながっていない背景の孔だけが 埋まり、外周とつながった凹みは埋まらない。HALCON の ``fill_up``（Fill up holes in regions.）に相当。 小さい連結領域を面積で除去する。HALCON の ``select_shape``（Choose regions with the aid of shape features.）に相当。
index_text.en: Segment — blob / coin segment smooth, threshold, fill holes, drop specks Isotropic Gaussian smoothing. Equivalent to HALCON's ``gauss_filter`` (Smooth using discrete Gauss functions.). Automatic thresholding using Otsu's method. Equivalent to HALCON's ``binary_threshold`` (Segment an image using binary thresholding.). Fills holes inside a region (areas completely surrounded by background) using ``ndimage.binary_fill_holes``. Only background holes that are not connected to the outer boundary are filled; indentations connected to the outer boundary are not filled. Equivalent to HALCON's ``fill_up`` (Fill up holes in regions.). Removes small connected regions based on area. Equivalent to HALCON's ``select_shape`` (Choose regions with the aid of shape features.).

index_text.ja: Count — blobs measure ends in a feature — the object count 等方ガウシアン平滑化。HALCON の ``gauss_filter``（Smooth using discrete Gauss functions.）に相当。 大津の判別分析法（Otsu's method）による自動しきい値処理。HALCON の ``binary_threshold``（Segment an image using binary thresholding.）に相当。 領域内部の穴(背景に完全に囲まれた領域)を埋める (``ndimage.binary_fill_holes``)。外周とつながっていない背景の孔だけが 埋まり、外周とつながった凹みは埋まらない。HALCON の ``fill_up``（Fill up holes in regions.）に相当。 連結成分の個数を数える(``ndimage.label``、既定 8 連結)。HALCON の ``count_obj``/``connection`` の既定と同じ 8 連結を採用しており、斜めに 接する 2 つの塊は 1 個として数える(4 連結にすると過剰カウントになる例 =セルカウントで実測 342 個 vs 327 個、コード内コメント参照)。HALCON の ``count_obj``（Number of objects in a tuple.）に相当。
index_text.en: Count — blobs measure ends in a feature — the object count Isotropic Gaussian smoothing. Equivalent to HALCON's ``gauss_filter`` (Smooth using discrete Gauss functions.). Automatic thresholding using Otsu's method. Equivalent to HALCON's ``binary_threshold`` (Segment an image using binary thresholding.). Fills holes inside a region (areas completely surrounded by background) using ``ndimage.binary_fill_holes``. Only background holes that are not connected to the outer boundary are filled; indentations connected to the outer boundary are not filled. Equivalent to HALCON's ``fill_up`` (Fill up holes in regions.). Counts the number of connected components (``ndimage.label``, default 8-connectivity). Uses 8-connectivity, the same default as HALCON's ``count_obj``/``connection``, so two blobs touching diagonally are counted as one (an example where switching to 4-connectivity causes over-counting -- measured cell counts of 342 vs. 327; see the in-code comment). index_text.ja: Shape — distance transform shape distance to background inside each region 等方ガウシアン平滑化。HALCON の ``gauss_filter``（Smooth using discrete Gauss functions.）に相当。 大津の判別分析法（Otsu's method）による自動しきい値処理。HALCON の ``binary_threshold``（Segment an image using binary thresholding.）に相当。 ユークリッド距離変換(``ndimage.distance_transform_edt``)を最大値で 正規化した画像。各前景画素について最も近い背景画素までの距離を表す ―― 値が大きいほど領域の「奥」にある画素。出力は ``region`` ではなく ``image`` 型になる点に注意。HALCON の ``distance_transform``（Compute the distance transformation of a region.）に相当。
index_text.en: Shape — distance transform shape distance to background inside each region Isotropic Gaussian smoothing. Equivalent to HALCON's ``gauss_filter`` (Smooth using discrete Gauss functions.). Automatic thresholding using Otsu's method. Equivalent to HALCON's ``binary_threshold`` (Segment an image using binary thresholding.). An image obtained by normalizing the Euclidean distance transform (``ndimage.distance_transform_edt``) by its maximum value.
